messages.text: $0.09 CAD in winter.  $0.35 CAD in winter.

At 9¢ the Thor P2 runs about $11 CAD a month, at 35¢ about $42 — same 166 W either way, and $369 for 10 TH/s of real block draws.

Which one are you on most hours, the 9 or the 35?
9 for 8 months.  35 for 4.  I have solar panels that make me an exporter of power for 4 months of the summer.

Your solar changes the pick. Four TH is cheap for you — at 9¢ the Magic Miner 40T (40 TH/s, 650 W, $799) runs about $42 CAD a month, and in your export months it's effectively free. Four times the Thor's block draws.

Desk or garage?
Probably both.  Inside for winter.  Garage for summer.

That works well — 650 W indoors in winter is heat you'd be paying for anyway, and the garage takes the summer noise. Honest bit: it's about 50 dB in Eco mode, louder in Turbo, so not a bedroom machine.

Ships Nov 21, 2026. Want me to set up the checkout?
